title: Austin: Strategic Planning & Land Matters
summary:
*   City Council convened a special work session dedicated to **Strategic Planning** for the future of Austin.
*   Councilmembers also entered an executive session to privately discuss potential **land acquisitions**, ongoing **legal matters**, and future appointments to city boards and commissions.
*   No official actions or policy decisions were formally made during this meeting.

Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order the meeting of the Council on February 18, 1986, noting the presence of
all Councilmembers. He announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a work session on
Strategic Planning, which they did. Mayor Cooksey then announced Council would go into
Executive Session pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated to
discuss land acquisition, litigation and board and commission appointments. No official
action was taken as a result of executive session. Council adjourned its meeting at 6:30
p.m.

Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council on February 19, 1986, noting the
presence of all Councilmembers. Council held a work session on the Municipal Office
Complex-Finance and discussion of February 20 and February 27, 1986 agenda items.
Council did not hear the City Manager Reports as listed on the agenda, nor did they hold
an executive session.
The meeting was adjourned at 6:30 p.m.
